items.reason: The immediate branch does return without updating the row (packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/emailReminderManager.ts:213-222), but the claimed permanent orphaning is false: the cron deletes expired email reminders regardless of cancelled status (packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts:34-40). Workflow and step deletion also cascade to reminders (packages/prisma/schema.prisma:587,643), while rescheduling merely retains the cancelled batch's row until its scheduled date passes.
